name: Triangle Subdivision Voxelization
definition: A rasterization technique that subdivides triangle edges based on grid resolution and accuracy, sampling points and interpolated normals across the triangle surface to populate a 3D voxel grid.
summary: Triangle Subdivision Voxelization is a rasterization technique that subdivides triangle edges based on a fixed, resolution-dependent factor to uniformly populate a 3D voxel grid, differing from adaptive methods by prioritizing uniform sampling density over mesh refinement.
